[size=5]  [color=#f4f4f4][b]你是否觉得塞巴斯蒂安沉默寡言、很少谈论他自己？这个对话mod或许能让你更了解塞巴斯蒂安。
[/b][/color][/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=4][b][b][u][i]Do you think Sebastian is quiet and rarely talks about himself? This dialogue mod might help you understand him better.[/i][/u][/b][/b][/size][/color][size=5][color=#f4f4f4][b]
 
  脱离叛逆的表象，他对这个世界或许有着独到的见解，亦或者会有和屏幕前的你一样的人生困惑。
[/b][/color][/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=4][b][b][u][i]Beneath his rebellious exterior, he may have a unique perspective on the world or share the same life struggles as you[/i][/u][/b][/b][/size][/color][size=5][color=#f4f4f4][b]

[/i][/color][/size][/u]

                        [/size][size=5]   1.所有季节，周一到周日，0-10心的所有对话。[/size][size=4]
                          [i] [color=#d8d8d8]  [u] All dialogues from 0 to 10 hearts, Mon-Sun for ALL SEASONS.[/u][/color][/i]

                     [/size][size=5]      2.塞巴斯对所有可婚对象的结婚祝福。[/size][size=4]
                        [i] [color=#d8d8d8]     [u]Sebastian’s wedding blessings for all marriage candidates.[/u][/color][/i]

[/i]
                          [/size][size=5] 4.法师和几乎所有村民对塞巴斯的结婚祝福，不爱出门的除外。以及对婚后生活的问候（0、2或4心特定季节触发，每个人都不一样）。[/size][size=4]
                         [i] [color=#d8d8d8] [u]  Wedding blessings for Sebastian from the Wizard and almost all villagers (excluding those who rarely leave their homes), as well as greetings about married life (triggered in specific seasons at 0, 2, or 4 hearts, varying for each person).[/u][/color][/i]

                         [/size][size=5]  5.罗宾一家、山姆和阿比盖尔有关塞巴斯的对话扩展。包括约会、结婚、离婚和对他的看法。其中山姆有4句对话要求特定的季节和好感、并分布在塞巴斯8心和10心触发（触发不了也没事，当彩蛋玩吧）。
[/size][color=#cccccc][size=4]                          [i]   [u]D[/u][/i][i][u]ialogue expansions related to Sebastian for Robin’s family, Sam, and Abigail, covering dating, marriage, divorce, and their opinions about him. Sam has 4 dialogues that require specific seasons and friendship levels, triggered at 8 and 10 hearts with Sebastian (They're not necessary, just consider them as bonus scenes).[/u][/i][/size][/color][i][size=5]
[/size][/i][size=4]

[color=#cccccc][i]                        [/i][i]  [u] New gift dialogues, including Frog Eggs, Golden Pumpkin, Frozen Tear, Magic Rock Candy, Pearl, and birthday gifts.[/u][/i][/color]

[/size][size=4][color=#d8d8d8][i]                           [u]All dialogues at the Ginger Island resort.[/u][/i][/color][/size][size=5]

[/size][color=#cccccc][size=4]                           [i][u]Pre-festival dialogues for the first and second years (not every festival).[/u][/i][/size][/color][size=5]

[/size][color=#d8d8d8][size=4][i]                           [u]Endgame dialogues at the summit (Note: I haven’t tested this, so just forget it if it doesn’t work haha).[/u][/i][/size][/color][size=5]
